title: HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp: turn business APIs and databases into MCP tools
friendlyTitle: AnythingMCP connects AI assistants to existing business systems
summary: AnythingMCP is a self-hosted gateway that converts REST, SOAP, GraphQL, OData and SQL interfaces into MCP tools for AI assistants. The AGPL-licensed project advertises 265 connectors and had 550 stars with frequent updates when checked today.
friendlySummary: AnythingMCP can turn many kinds of APIs and databases into tools that Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients can use. It is self-hosted and includes a large connector catalogue.
whyItMatters: Teams can expose existing ERP, commerce and internal systems to agents through one tool layer rather than building every MCP integration from scratch. Start read-only, review generated tool descriptions and disable raw-response fallbacks where sensitive data could reach a model.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to test agent access to an existing system without building every connector yourself. Begin with read-only access and carefully check what data each tool returns.
